subject: general
question: Which of the following Indian musicians was referred to as ‘Ghazal King’?
solution:
The correct answer is **Jagjit Singh**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jagjit Singh** was a renowned Indian ghazal singer, composer, and musician.
 
• He is often referred to as the **"Ghazal King"** for his significant contributions to the genre.
 
• He popularized ghazal music not just in India, but around the world.
 
• His unique style and soulful voice made ghazal accessible to a wider audience.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 1: Ghulam Ali
 Ghulam Ali is a Pakistani ghazal singer of the Patiala Gharana. He is known for his unique style of ghazal singing.
 
 

 Option 2: Jagjit Singh
 Jagjit Singh was an Indian ghazal singer, composer, and musician, known as the "Ghazal King".
 
 

 Option 3: Pankaj Udhas
 Pankaj Udhas is an Indian ghazal singer who helped popularize the genre in India and abroad.
 
 

 Option 4: Mehdi Hassan
 Mehdi Hassan was a legendary Pakistani ghazal singer, often referred to as the "Shahenshah-e-Ghazal" (Emperor of Ghazal).
